"""Add a cover page to report.pdf using the pdf skill approach."""
import os
from datetime import date

from reportlab.lib.pagesizes import letter
from reportlab.pdfgen import canvas
from pypdf import PdfReader, PdfWriter

# 1. Create the cover page PDF with reportlab
cover_path = "cover_page.pdf"
c = canvas.Canvas(cover_path, pagesize=letter)
width, height = letter

# Title
c.setFont("Helvetica-Bold", 28)
c.drawCentredString(width / 2, height - 300, "Annual Financial Report")

# Current date
c.setFont("Helvetica", 16)
c.drawCentredString(width / 2, height - 340, date.today().strftime("%B %d, %Y"))

c.save()
print("Created cover page:", cover_path)

# 2. Merge the cover page with report.pdf
reader = PdfReader("report.pdf")
print("report.pdf pages:", len(reader.pages))

writer = PdfWriter()
cover_reader = PdfReader(cover_path)
writer.add_page(cover_reader.pages[0])  # Cover page first
for page in reader.pages:
    writer.add_page(page)

with open("report_with_cover.pdf", "wb") as output:
    writer.write(output)

print("Created report_with_cover.pdf with", len(writer.pages), "pages")
